properties.entry: SELECT C.CATEGORY_NAME, SUM(T.TRANS_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN PERSONAL_CATEGORIES C ON T.CATEGORY_NUM = C.CATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.USER_NUM = ? AND T.TRANS_TYPE = ? AND TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY C.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY TOTAL_AMOUNT DESC

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_INCOME, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND TO_CHAR(TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') = ? AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS TRANS_MONTH, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_INCOME, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS TOTAL_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND TRANS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), -5) AND TRANS_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM'), 1) AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY TRANS_MONTH ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANS_DATE, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'I' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY_INCOME, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN TRANS_TYPE = 'E' THEN TRANS_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS DAILY_EXPENSE FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS WHERE USER_NUM = ? AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT T.TRANS_NUM, T.TRANS_TYPE, C.CATEGORY_NAME, T.TRANS_AMOUNT, TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRANS_DATE, T.TRANS_MEMO FROM PERSONAL_TRANSACTIONS T JOIN PERSONAL_CATEGORIES C ON T.CATEGORY_NUM = C.CATEGORY_NUM WHERE T.USER_NUM = ? AND T.USE_YN = 'Y'
